title: Supreme Court refuses to reconstitute HPEC, orders pellet gun enquiry first
detail: India's Supreme Court refused to reconstitute the High-Powered Enquiry Committee on NEET-UG protests, ruling that an inquiry into pellet gun use and security excesses must come first before any committee changes.

media.caption: Supreme Court refuses HPEC reconstitution, mandates pellet gun inquiry first

title: CID Arrests Four More Accused, Total Exam-Scam Arrests Pass 30
detail: A day after the Sanjeet Kumar and Dilip Kumar Paswan arrests, Jharkhand's CID arrests four more accused: Hrithik Roshan (Mango, Jamshedpur) and Pankaj Prasun (Sukhdevnagar, Ranchi) in the JPSC case (No. 16/2026), allegedly benefiting via Sanjeet Kumar's coaching network, plus Rajesh Prasad Yadav (Koderma) and Sandeep Kumar in the JSSC-CGL case (No. 01/2025). All four are sent to judicial custody after preliminary interrogation, taking the total arrested and jailed in the recruitment-exam scam to over 30, including former JPSC Chairman L. Khiangte, former examination controller Shweta Gupta, examination-agency official Ramveer Singh and alleged kingpin Abhay Tiwari.

media.caption: CID sends four more accused to judicial custody, taking total exam-scam arrests past 30, Sep 16, 2026.
